Draw a figure from its design

Source: R/fig_design.R
preview_figure.Rd

Runs a design's script on the study's data, as the figure's program will (in a temporary folder, so nothing of the study changes), and gives the PNG it saves – at its size on the page (step 4, Page and output) – with the design's problems and the figure checks. The Plot Designer's preview.

Usage

preview_figure(
  study,
  output_id,
  design = fig_design(study$planner, output_id),
  max_px = NULL
)

Arguments

study

An rtfstudy.

output_id

The figure.

design

The design (default: the figure's).

max_px

For the screen: at most this many pixels wide (the PNG is drawn at a lower dpi, same size); NULL draws it as saved.

Value

A list: png (the file, NULL when it failed), size (its width, height, units and dpi), advice (what is usually wanted and missing, see tflspec::tfl_fig_advice()), problems (the design against the schema and the data, see tflspec::tfl_check_fig_design()), warnings (the figure checks and the plot's own warnings), error (NULL or the message), code, objects (what the data steps made, each in short: see below).

objects is a list by name (df, then each object a step makes: a KM fit, summary statistics, the ARD's statistics ...), each a list: class; for a data frame rows, columns and head (its first 6 rows), for anything else text (the first lines it prints). Those made before an error are there.

Examples

# a home in the temporary folder: used in this R session only, nothing
# is written to your settings
old <- options(tflplanner.home = NULL)
setup_tflplanner(home = tempfile("tflplanner-home"))
#> The home /tmp/RtmpTnNlOL/tflplanner-home1b1835faa711 is in the temporary folder: it is used in this R session only, not remembered for later ones.
#> tflplanner home: /tmp/RtmpTnNlOL/tflplanner-home1b1835faa711
#> new studies go to: /tmp/RtmpTnNlOL/tflplanner-home1b1835faa711/studies
# \donttest{
# (about 10 seconds: it makes the sample study, its ARD and the figure)
s <- save_study(create_sample_study(run = FALSE))
#> The sample study: /tmp/RtmpTnNlOL/tflplanner-home1b1835faa711/studies/SAMPLE-01
update_study_ard(s, "T-14-2-2")  # the ARD the figure reads
#> $ok
#> [1] TRUE
#> 
#> $rows
#> [1] 117
#> 
#> $error
#> NULL
#> 
#> $output
#>  [1] ""                                                      
#>  [2] "Attaching package: ‘dplyr’"                            
#>  [3] ""                                                      
#>  [4] "The following objects are masked from ‘package:stats’:"
#>  [5] ""                                                      
#>  [6] "    filter, lag"                                       
#>  [7] ""                                                      
#>  [8] "The following objects are masked from ‘package:base’:" 
#>  [9] ""                                                      
#> [10] "    intersect, setdiff, setequal, union"               
#> [11] ""                                                      
#> [12] "T-14-2-2: 117 rows into output/ard/ard.rds"            
#> 
p <- preview_figure(s, "F-14-2-3")
p$png      # the picture, in a temporary folder
#> [1] "/tmp/RtmpTnNlOL/tflplanner-fig-1b1831a9cd1e/output/F-14-2-3.png"
p$size     # its size on the page
#> $width
#> [1] 8.33
#> 
#> $height
#> [1] 4.79
#> 
#> $units
#> [1] "in"
#> 
#> $dpi
#> [1] 300
#> 
# }
options(old)
